text: Facebook earnings soar despite recent privacy controversies Thursday, 31 January 2019 ( 15 hours ago ) Facebook saw revenue grow by 30 percent to $6.9 billion in the fourth quarter, and its monthly active users rose 9 percent. CNET senior producer Dan Patterson joins CBSN to discuss the latest Facebook news. Facebook easily beat Wall Street’s profit estimates when it reported earnings Wednesday, soothing investor concerns about rising costs amid a slew of privacy-related scandals. Chris Dignam has more.
